media.title: Twelve Claude Code agents drive separate iOS simulators in parallel

title: Run Twelve iOS Simulator Agents in Parallel
summary: interlap reports running twelve Claude Code agents, each with its own iOS Simulator, on a 16 GB M1 Pro after stripping unnecessary simulator services; two agents recovered from bad assumptions and completed the task. An iOS team can use the experiment to size isolated simulator workers before scaling parallel QA.
takeaway: Benchmark one isolated simulator worker first, require screenshots and completed-task evidence, then increase concurrency while watching memory, swap, simulator state, and recovery behavior.
